conservative_interval.bounds: exact positive decimal Criterion median interval bounds

aggregation.cross_system_ratio: median of the six same-block exact ratios A/B; the even-count median is the exact rational arithmetic mean of the two middle ratios
aggregation.display: rounded display strings never feed a decision
aggregation.number_parsing: every Criterion JSON number token is parsed as an exact decimal rational; binary floats never feed a decision
aggregation.ratio_encoding: reduced [numerator, denominator] pair of decimal-integer strings with a positive denominator
aggregation.table_estimate: median of the six process-level Criterion medians; for an even count the exact arithmetic mean of the two middle decimal values

winner_rule.A: upper endpoint < 1 in all six blocks
winner_rule.B: lower endpoint > 1 in all six blocks
winner_rule.nature: declared descriptive consistency rule, not a hypothesis test

argv_forms.rules: the last token must be exactly one --bench; the remaining tokens must match exactly one form in literal order; anything else is a usage error

smoke.rule: cargo test --all-targets entry: metadata round trip, group order assertions, synthetic config rejection; no env reads, no proof, no Criterion; exit 0

bench_profile.manifest_block:
[profile.bench]
opt-level = 3
debug = false
strip = "none"
debug-assertions = false
overflow-checks = false
lto = "fat"
codegen-units = 1
incremental = false
bench_profile.note: byte-identical explicit [profile.bench] in both repositories; cargo ignores an explicit panic setting for the bench profile and always unwinds

boundary_notes: Per-proof trace creation is inside prove_e2e because limber allocates w/q in its closure.
public_statement_for and bind_public_statement are outside verify_core; only the canonical checks and the native verifier are inside. They are inside the diagnostic verify_e2e.
validate_trace runs once in preflight and never inside a group.
Both comparable groups use iter_batched(setup, routine, BatchSize::PerIteration), never iter or iter_batched_ref.

prove_e2e: the Zinc setup is exactly || (); the routine returns an owned ProveSampleOutput = (trace, proof) that Criterion destroys after measurement.end; limber returns its witness, instance and proof.

verify_core: the statement is bound once before timing; each per-iteration setup clones exactly one proof (untimed); the routine consumes the owned clone and returns () after black-boxing the result, so proof destruction is inside timing on both sides. No statement or verifier key is cloned per iteration.

cargo_config_allowlist.discovery: invocation directory, each ancestor up to /, then CARGO_HOME (deduplicated by realpath); no --config flag is ever added
cargo_config_allowlist.recheck: full candidate discovery immediately before and after every Cargo subprocess; any appearing, disappearing or changed candidate or manifest is fatal

closed_environment.linker_variable_rule: CARGO_TARGET_ + host triple upper-cased with - replaced by _ + _LINKER; value = the CC launcher path
closed_environment.policy: a fresh mapping with exactly the allowlisted names; every inherited name is cleared before the audited values are injected; children receive nothing else

criterion.batching: comparable groups: iter_batched(setup, routine, BatchSize::PerIteration); never iter or iter_batched_ref
criterion.saved_baseline: none requested; children start from an empty output directory

criterion_output.authoritative_identity: benchmark.json: group_id, function_id, value_str, full_id, directory_name, title; the truncated directory name is never parsed for identity
criterion_output.directory_component_rule: the id component with each of the characters ? " / \ * < > : | ^ replaced by _ and truncated to 64 bytes at a character boundary; an empty value_str contributes an empty trailing component (directory_name ends with /)
criterion_output.directory_name_check: the directory holding base/ and new/ must equal directory_name with empty components removed
criterion_output.full_id_rule: group_id/function_id/value_str (a trailing / when value_str is empty)
criterion_output.title_collision_rule: Criterion keeps titles unique per process: when a benchmark's title (full_id truncated per title_rule) equals an earlier registration's title, it appends " #N" with N starting at 2 in registration order (report.rs ensure_title_unique). This happens for the Zinc diagnostic steps group, whose function_id exceeds the 100-byte title limit so every step shares the truncated title. Validators accept exactly the derived title or the derived title followed by " #N" (N >= 2) and require all titles of a tree to be distinct; directory names stay unique through the value_str directory and never carry a suffix.
criterion_output.title_rule: full_id truncated to 100 bytes followed by ... when full_id exceeds 100 bytes, else full_id

evidence.executable_rule: regular non-symlink strict descendant of the role target; target-relative path, size and sha256 recorded and rehashed per recheck_policy

feature_insertion.parallel: T > 1 inserts --features parallel before --bench poseidon in evidence/metadata/child and --features zinc-protocol/parallel in bootstrap; gates never add a feature

evidence.gate_profile: dev: the two correctness gates run under the default cargo test profile in the role target; only the evidence build and the Criterion children use the bench profile
evidence.native_line_rule: every `[<pkg> <ver>] running:` command (after cd/env prefixes) must be an injected launcher path or the sdk probe; every `<NAME> = ...` read of CC/CXX/AR/RANLIB must be Some(<injected>); absolute paths must lie under the role target, the repository, an audited dependency root or native_path_roots
evidence.source_root_rule: every CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR of a -vv Running record lies under the repository or an audited registry/git dependency root; no fourth root

identity_projection.boundary: a root matches at the start of a value or after one of ' :=,;()[] or a URL scheme (file://), and must be followed by the end of the value, /, :, ;, ,, #, ) or ]
identity_projection.precedence: longest raw prefix first; ties in token list order; each root also matches its realpath alias
identity_projection.raw_values: only in run evidence (build-profile.json environment.raw, journals); never in configs, compatibility keys or identities

limber.diagnostic_groups_note: advice is backend independent and is registered by the hyrax role only; brakedown registers the other three in the same literal order; diagnostics are never given a cross-system ratio
limber.prove_e2e_requirement: fresh w/q construction and commitment inside the timed closure, prover randomness regenerated from the pinned benchmark coins inside timing
limber.verify_core_requirement: verify_poseidon_chain against a shape-bound prebuilt native instance with the same three canonical digest checks inside timing
limber.verify_e2e_requirement: not comparable: limber has no exact native counterpart; if reported it is diagnostic only

forbidden: a compiler path other than RUSTC

normalization.cfg_feature: limber pins `--cfg feature="default"` and its own --check-cfg value list as literal tokens of its role; Zinc has no --cfg feature token
normalization.env_prefix: leading NAME=value tokens of the -vv Running record are the environment, the next token is the compiler and must equal the injected RUSTC
normalization.linker: -C linker=<NATIVE_CC>: cargo passes the injected target-linker variable (the audited CC launcher path) to every rustc invocation
normalization.strip: no -C strip token: the pinned [profile.bench] sets strip = "none", which cargo does not forward

rustc_argv_grammar.parallel_note: no grammar is pinned for --features parallel; evidence_build fails closed until a captured -vv log pins it
